=== zero page for constants and labels known before use, absolute otherwise
ptr     = $80
        .org $0200
start:  lda ptr
        sta ptr+1
        lda (ptr),y
        lda later
        sta later,x
        lda start
        lda a:ptr
        ldx z:later
        jmp start
later   = $40
later2  = $1234
=== a label after org is an address, and zero page when it fits
        .org $0010
var:    .byte 0
table:  .byte 1, 2, 3
code:   lda var
        ldx table,y
        sta table,x
        inc var
        lda fwd
fwd:    rts
=== forward references are absolute even when they turn out small
        lda zp1
        sta zp1,x
        ldy zp2
        cpx zp2
zp1     = $10
zp2     = $20
=== zero page only forms with a forward reference
        stx store,y
        lda (vec,x)
        lda (vec),y
store   = $30
vec     = $fe
=== byte selectors give zero page addressing
        .org $1000
        lda <msg
        lda >msg,x
        lda #<msg
        ldx #>msg
        .byte <msg, >msg
        .word msg
msg:    .byte "hi", 0
=== branches forward and back at the ends of their range
        .org $8000
top:    bne fwd
        .res 127, $ea
fwd:    beq top2
top2:   .res 126, $ea
        bcc top2
=== a reset routine laid out at its ROM address
        .org $f000
reset:  sei
        cld
        ldx #$ff
        txs
        lda #0
        ldx #0
clear:  sta $00,x
        sta $0100,x
        sta $0200,x
        inx
        bne clear
        jsr init
        jmp main
init:   lda #<irq
        sta $fffe
        lda #>irq
        sta $ffff
        rts
main:   jmp main
irq:    rti
=== data directives
        .org $c000
        .byte 1, $02, %11, 'a', "bc"
        .byt 4
        .word $1234, *
        .addr main
        .dbyt $1234
        .dword $12345678
        .res 3
        .res 2, $ff
        .asciiz "ok"
        .lobytes $1234, main
        .hibytes $1234, main
main:   rts
=== equates in terms of each other and of labels
count   = 10
double  = count * 2
        .org $0400
base:   ldx #count
        ldy #double
        lda base+count
        lda #<(base + $100)
        lda #>(base + $100)
top     := base
        jmp top
=== the location counter
        .org $0300
        lda *
        jmp *
        .word *, * + 2
        bne *+4
        nop
        nop
=== instructions in the first column, as ca65 allows
        .org $0600
lda #1
sta $0200
loop: dex
bne loop
rts
=== comments and case
        .org $0600      ; origin
Start:  LDA #$01        ; load
        STA $0200
        Lda Value       ; mixed case mnemonic
        JMP Start
Value   = $FE
=== a scrolling message loop
        .org $0801
        ldx #0
next:   lda text,x
        beq done
        jsr chrout
        inx
        bne next
done:   rts
chrout  = $ffd2
text:   .byte "HELLO, WORLD", 13, 0
=== a 16-bit add through a zero-page pointer
lo      = $fb
hi      = $fc
        .org $2000
add16:  clc
        lda lo
        adc #<$0123
        sta lo
        lda hi
        adc #>$0123
        sta hi
        ldy #0
        lda (lo),y
        rts
=== conditional assembly
debug   = 1
        .org $1000
        .if debug
        brk
        .else
        nop
        .endif
        .ifdef debug
        lda #1
        .endif
        .ifndef nodebug
        lda #2
        .endif
        rts
=== macros with named parameters, and repeats
        .macro  load val, addr
        lda #val
        sta addr
        .endmacro
        load 1, $0200
        load $ff, $10
        .repeat 3
        nop
        .endrep
